levels.black_point: IRE 3 — lifted. Never 0. Crushed blacks read as video.
levels.shadow_roll: long and soft; shadow detail retained to IRE 8
levels.midtone: gamma 1.05, slightly open — faces sit in the upper mids
levels.highlight_roll: compressed from IRE 85; nothing clips to 100
levels.white_point: IRE 96 on the brightest lamp flame only

shadow_tint.hue: warm neutral, a trace of ochre
shadow_tint.note: NEVER blue. Blue shadows are the single clearest tell of a Western grade.

skin_qualifier.rule: Skin is protected. No global saturation or luminance move may lighten a face. A qualifier holds skin at its locked albedo.
skin_qualifier.check: Sample a face before and after grade. If the albedo moved, revert.

grain.why: Generated frames are too clean and read as synthetic without it. Grain is not a style choice here; it is what makes the image look photographed.

PLC-SABHA.key: high lattice, frame-left, hard-edged bars across stone
PLC-SABHA.time: M1–M6: one audience, from morning. M7 interiors: afternoon through the same lattice, frame-left kept for continuity. Artistic.

PLC-GATE.key: afternoon sun from frame-left, lower in the west
PLC-GATE.time: M7 TIME CONTINUITY — ARTISTIC, NOT SOURCED: the afternoon of the same day. M1–M6 is one audience that begins in the morning; the source gives no hour for the departure, and they reach the Sarayū by nightfall (21.9).

PLC-ROAD.key: afternoon sun from frame-left, lower in the west as they walk
